meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: Claude 会说「HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!」并指挥 5 位立场互相敌对的 AI 评审员交叉抨击方案。只有撑过攻击的结论被留下,再强制交给另一个负责写执行计划的 plan 智能体。
howto.when: 当你说出「hyperplan」「hpp」「/hyperplan」等触发词,或在要求规划必须严格、想暴露薄弱假设与盲点时触发。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我拆解这个功能上线的步骤。
say.note: 会先启动 5 人对抗小组交叉评审。

say.text: hpp: 对抗式评审现有重构方案,找出薄弱假设。
say.note: 成员会互相攻击,只留下证据充分的结论。

say.text: /hyperplan 做上线计划,要求暴露盲点和过度设计。
say.note: 合格结论会交给 plan 智能体生成执行计划。

howto.what_en: Claude announces 'HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!' and orchestrates 5 hostile AI members who cross-critique each other's findings. Surviving insights go through the plan agent to be formalized into an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered by keywords like 'hyperplan', 'hpp', or '/hyperplan', or when the user requests a plan with maximum rigor — surfacing weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to help break down the launch steps for this feature.
hpp: adversarial review of the current refactor plan, surface weak assumptions.
say_en.note: Members attack each other; only evidenced conclusions survive.

say_en.text: /hyperplan make a release plan, surfacing blind spots and over-engineering.
say_en.note: Surviving insights are handed to the plan agent for formalization.
